title: leptidium molle
intro: Leptidium molle, commonly known as field pepperwort, is a small annual plant belonging to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). The health benefits of Leptidium molle include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues. Therapeutically, it is used for its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Leptidium molle include glucosinolates, which have been found to have antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
